description: Returns the sourced facts we hold for one product barcode (GTIN-8/12/13/14): product name, brand, short statements each with its source link, licence and check date, recall records naming the code, and our page for the product. Use it to look up or cite what a product is. Do not use it for prices, stock, reviews or sellers; it has none. Most barcodes return state no_facts, which is not a safety statement.

barcode.description: The product barcode as digits only: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid check digit.

name: barcode_facts
title: Product facts by barcode
